about.text: Mashrika Projects is a leading industrial engineering and turnkey solutions company delivering high-performance HVAC systems, industrial piping, automation, electrical infrastructure, and maintenance solutions across commercial and industrial sectors.

services.title: HVAC Systems & Ventilation
services.text: GI/SS ducting, AHU setup, balancing and commissioning.

services.title: Industrial Piping Solutions
services.text: IBR and non-IBR fabrication with plant-grade quality control.

services.title: Electrical Infrastructure
services.text: Panels, transformers, cable routing, and installation services.

services.title: Industrial Automation
services.text: PLC, VFD, soft starter, and servo drive engineering.

services.title: Temperature & Humidity Control
services.text: RH and temperature maintenance for critical environments.

services.title: False Ceiling & Commercial Interiors
services.text: Commercial ceiling and utility-ready interior execution.

services.title: AMC & Maintenance Services
services.text: 24/7 preventive and breakdown support for plant continuity.
